current_suggestion.pitch: Your AI consumption skews toward capability showcases and end-user applications (Huberman, Lex, Rogan), which means you're missing rigorous interrogation of *why* models behave as they do — the mechanistic and scientific layer just above infrastructure. Machine Learning Street Talk interviews researchers who explain what's actually happening inside models at a conceptual level: emergent capabilities, alignment, scaling limits, and what those mean for what AI can and can't do next. It's long-form and technically honest without being a dev-tooling channel, making it the missing middle ground between Lex's philosophy-leaning conversations and pure benchmark noise.
